subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: LH FSH Ratio, Metabolic Screening and Weight Management

steps.tx: Inappropriate gonadotropin secretion with LH exceeding FSH was the classic **LH FSH ratio** of PCOS. Ratios over two were once diagnostic fashion. Modern criteria dropped it because obesity blunts LH and assays vary. Careful history taking and examination help place this finding in the right clinical context before treatment is planned.
steps.say: The LH FSH ratio was classic in PCOS but modern criteria dropped it.

steps.tx: Rapid GnRH pulses favour LH over FSH secretion, explaining the ratio by **pulse frequency encoding**. The persistently fast pulse generator of PCOS also prevents the FSH rise needed for ovulation. This is the neuroendocrine heart of the syndrome. Correlating this finding with imaging and laboratory results prevents both delayed treatment and unnecessary intervention in most patients.
steps.say: Pulse frequency encoding favours LH in PCOS and starves FSH for ovulation.

steps.tx: Glucose tolerance, lipids and blood pressure form the **metabolic screening panel** at diagnosis. Impaired glucose tolerance affects a third of women with PCOS. Screening repeats by risk, at least every few years. Early recognition matters because timely treatment gives clearly better outcomes than waiting for complications to develop first.
steps.say: Metabolic screening at diagnosis finds impaired glucose tolerance in a third.

steps.tx: Five to ten percent weight loss restoring ovulation in over half is the power of **weight management first**. It precedes fertility drugs in overweight PCOS by every guideline. Structured programmes beat advice alone substantially. Students should connect this fact with the presenting symptoms, since examination questions usually test that clinical link directly.
steps.say: Weight management first restores ovulation in over half with five percent loss.

steps.tx: Metformin improves insulin sensitivity and modestly aids ovulation as **metabolic therapy**. Its best role is impaired glucose tolerance and diabetes prevention. Gastrointestinal effects limit dose escalation in many. Documenting this finding clearly in the notes guides the next clinician and supports safe, well planned further management.
steps.say: Metformin aids ovulation modestly and prevents diabetes in impaired tolerance.

steps.tx: Sleep apnoea, fatty liver and depression cluster with PCOS as **associated comorbidities**. Screening questions for snoring and mood belong in reviews. Treating them improves fertility outcomes indirectly. When this picture is seen in practice, urgent senior review is wise whenever there is any doubt about severity.
steps.say: Associated comorbidities include sleep apnoea, fatty liver and depression in PCOS.

steps.tx: Endometrial protection with progestogen at least every three months prevents hyperplasia in amenorrhoeic PCOS, termed **endometrial protection rule**. Withdrawal bleeds are induced when cycles exceed ninety days. This simple rule prevents cancers. Understanding this mechanism explains the symptoms, the investigation findings and the logic behind each step of treatment given.
steps.say: Endometrial protection induces withdrawal when cycles exceed ninety days in PCOS.

steps.tx: Anti Mullerian hormone runs two to three times normal in PCOS reflecting follicle excess, an emerging **AMH criterion**. Adult criteria increasingly accept it instead of ultrasound morphology. Adolescents remain excluded from this substitution. This distinction changes management, so it should be settled early rather than after empirical treatment has already begun.
steps.say: AMH runs high in PCOS and increasingly substitutes for ultrasound in adults.

steps.tx: Bariatric surgery in severe obesity restores ovulation and fertility dramatically, termed **surgical metabolic therapy**. Pregnancy is deferred twelve to eighteen months while weight stabilises. Diabetes remission accompanies the fertility return. Careful history taking and examination help place this finding in the right clinical context before treatment is planned.
steps.say: Surgical metabolic therapy restores ovulation in severe obesity after weight stabilises.
